runes.name: Fleet Footwork
runes.limitation: Healing and short movement speed are modeled; mana/energy restoration, the next-attack 40% Attack Speed clause, and exact energized timing are contextual.

runes.name: Aery
runes.limitation: Damage, shield and return cooldown are modeled, but exact travel distance and whether each cast attacks or shields depend on positioning and ally targeting.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying
runes.limitation: Champion damage and the ranged modifier are modeled; permanent Health earned from earlier lane procs is match-history dependent.

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.limitation: Uses the documented 15-minute value; actual value depends on game time.

runes.name: Triumph
runes.limitation: Requires a takedown; the reference fight does not assume one before its result.

runes.name: Manaflow Band
runes.limitation: The completed 300-mana value is modeled; actual stacking progress depends on earlier champion hits.

runes.name: Phase Rush
runes.limitation: Movement speed and Ability Haste are approximated; the one-time 20% current basic-cooldown refund and exact three-hit trigger timing are not modeled.

runes.name: Bone Plating
runes.limitation: Represented as a conservative fight-level reduction; exact damage blocked by the next three champion hits is unavailable in the source data.

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.limitation: The documented healing and melee doubling use a 40% missing-Health fight state; exact repeated-damage timing is contextual.

runes.name: Demolish
runes.limitation: Affects turrets only, not champion combat.

runes.name: Nimbus Cloak
runes.limitation: Uses a fight-uptime movement estimate because the engine does not receive summoner-cast timing.

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.limitation: The 10 Ability Haste is modeled; the level-9 per-ability cooldown refund is not.

runes.name: Perseverance
runes.limitation: Tenacity is modeled permanently and the resistance window is approximated; enemy immobilize timing is contextual.

runes.name: First Strike
runes.limitation: The three-second damage window is modeled; whether the user struck first and its gold income are not.

runes.name: Eyeball Collector
runes.limitation: The engine assumes completed stacks; takedown progress is match-history dependent.

runes.name: Ingenious Hunter
runes.limitation: Removed in patch 7.3.

runes.name: Zombie Ward
runes.limitation: Completed adaptive stacks are modeled; ward takedowns and vision utility are match-history/context dependent.

runes.name: Last Stand
runes.limitation: Uses an expected low-health uptime rather than an incoming-damage timeline tied to the user's current Health.

runes.name: Legend: Alacrity
runes.limitation: The maximum 18% Attack Speed is modeled for the full-build comparison; actual farm/takedown stack progress is match-history dependent.

runes.name: Legend: Tenacity
runes.limitation: Removed in patch 7.3.

runes.name: Legend: Haste
runes.limitation: The maximum 15 Ability Haste is modeled for the full-build comparison; actual farm/takedown stack progress is match-history dependent.

runes.name: Legend: Bloodline
runes.limitation: The guaranteed 1% omnivamp is modeled; seven takedown/farm stacks are not granted for free.

runes.name: Overgrowth
runes.limitation: Thirty stacks and the 3% threshold bonus are modeled; indefinite later farming is not assumed.

runes.name: Revitalize
runes.limitation: The unconditional 5% is modeled; the additional low-health amplification is disclosed as contextual.

runes.name: Hextech Flashtraption
runes.limitation: Engage mobility is real but has no direct damage or durability value inside the synthetic fight.

runes.name: Empowerment
runes.limitation: Proc damage and the post-three-attack 8% amp are modeled from the expected attack timeline; interruptions and exiting champion combat remain contextual.

runes.name: Arcane Comet
runes.limitation: Base proc, ratios and cooldown are modeled; the per-hit growth of later comets is not accumulated.

runes.name: Ixtali Seedjar
runes.limitation: Plant/trinket utility is outside the synthetic fight.

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.limitation: Ultimate damage amplification is modeled, including the AoE split; ultimate healing/shielding amplification is not yet included in support value.

runes.name: Unshakeable
runes.limitation: The ordinary one-enemy 5% Armor/MR state is modeled; nearby-enemy count can raise it to 9% and the three-enemy slow resistance is contextual.

runes.name: Ice Overlord
runes.limitation: Damage and its temporary resistance layer are modeled and CC-gated; zone slow and sticking value are not.

runes.name: Botanist
runes.limitation: Plant and gold utility is outside champion combat.

runes.name: Hubris
runes.limitation: Requires a takedown; its temporary Adaptive Force begins after the reference fight's result.

runes.name: Absolute Focus
runes.limitation: Adaptive stats are modeled as a fresh-fight ceiling; uptime after falling below 65% Health is contextual.

runes.name: Guardian
runes.limitation: Self/ally shields and ally proximity uptime are modeled; exact guard targeting and damage threshold are contextual.

runes.name: Relentless Hunter
runes.limitation: Out-of-combat movement is rotation/map utility, not an in-fight stat.
